$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: a domain is covered when the report states a status for it, and this
report states none for Maintainability. Every finding in that section is spelled PARTIAL, which is
outside the four statuses nfr-status-definitions.md defines, so the section carries a heading, four
thresholds, four evidence citations, and no answer.
It is the shape a heading-counting coverage check cannot see. The section is there, so the count that
reads headings alone is four of four, and the domain Step 4 dispatched a worker for is still
It is gapped-correct-audit with the Maintainability section's four Status lines respelled and the
prose around them made to agree; the thresholds, the evidence and every other section are unchanged.
derivation: Maintainability: STATUS_LINE recognises PASS, CONCERNS, FAIL and N/A, so it matches none of the four
lines and the section records no status at all. rollupStatus over an empty list is null.
Coverage: four headings, three of them stating a readable status. The two numbers differ here and
nowhere else in the corpus, which is what the pair is for: gapped-domain-omitted has three of each.
Maintainability reports nothing, which is a status miss against an expected CONCERNS. It is not an
unsupported PASS: a domain with no status was not passed.
Thresholds: the section exists, so its threshold lines are read, and the first of them still names
80%. 4 of 4. This is what separates the case from gapped-domain-omitted, where the absent section
leaves no threshold line to read at all.
The other three domains, the overall status, the unknown-threshold check and the evidence-gap list
are gapped-correct-audit's, unchanged. Overall stays FAIL because reliability is still FAIL.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.
Before a stated status was required, coverage read four of four on this report and the only thing
that fell to the unreadable section was the status miss.
Citations: gapped-correct-audit's nineteen, unchanged. Only the four Status lines were respelled, so the
Maintainability section still carries its four Evidence lines and cites four files while stating no status

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
